text.content:
A junction of old routes, Restless enough that it's clearly seen more use than the maps suggest.

GM Notes

Milestone: A sign of the floor's deeper story: the Bone Choir never got the burial it was owed, and it intends to make everyone still breathing understand why that matters.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 18 to detect and counter).

Encounter: A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on.
